itemdesc-lampbelt-temporal: Four temporal gears seated in a tinker's belt, feeding a brass hip lamp that never needs filling. Wear it and your hands stay free. Dye it in a barrel to change the light.
lampwright:itemdesc-lampbelt-temporal: Four temporal gears seated in a tinker's belt, feeding a brass hip lamp that never needs filling. Wear it and your hands stay free. Dye it in a barrel to change the light.
item-handbooktext-lampbelt-temporal:
Pour at least 1 litre of dye into a barrel, then seal the belt in with it for 4 hours. Liquid does not go in by dragging it into the barrel window - hold the bucket in your hand and right-click the barrel itself, then right-click again with an empty hand to open it and drop the belt into its one item slot. Only 1 litre is used, so the rest stays in the barrel for the next belt.

Any colour dyes straight to any other. A temporal gear in place of the dye returns the belt to its original cyan.

The dyes themselves are made in a barrel as well: yellow from an onion or a heather flower, blue from a cornflower or crushed lapis lazuli, red from crushed cinnabar, orange from yellow dye and an onion, white from borax powder.

Re-dyeing a worn belt also restores it to full condition.
